solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Meal with crowd freely guzzling cold and hot soup

indicators.note: something guzzling takes the next pieces in, swallowing them inside
letters moving freely are shuffled into a new arrangement

parts.note: C is the standard abbreviation for cold, as on a tap
H is the standard abbreviation for hot, as on a tap

explanation.surface: A crowd greedily wolfing down a meal of cold and hot soup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'freely' makes CLAMOWDER, and 'guzzling' takes in the cold and hot taps' letters; 'Meal' looks like the definition but is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A chowder made with clams is a thick New England-style soup, so this is an example of the defined dish.

clue.text: Zero travelling up: zero leaving English city

indicators.note: in a down entry, travelling up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: nil is zero

indicators.note: something leaving is taken away

parts.note: the punctuation mark in the clue is a colon
O is the figure zero

explanation.surface: Something headed upward, then nothing departing from an English city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'travelling up' turns NIL into LIN; the clue's own colon is COLON, and 'leaving' removes one O from it.
explanation.definitionFit: The cathedral city in the East Midlands is an English city.

clue.text: Slow vehicle needs to exploit spare cash

parts.note: to milk a situation is to exploit it
a float is a small sum of cash kept for change

explanation.surface: A slow car being bought by someone who wants to make use of extra money.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain milk was delivered to doorsteps by small, slow electric vans.
explanation.definitionFit: An electric milk delivery van famously trundles along at low speed, an example of a slow vehicle.

clue.text: I put on clothes in lift

indicators.note: used as a verb, so these letters dress or surround the I

parts.note: to host an event is to put it on

explanation.surface: Someone getting dressed while in an elevator.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clothes' is a verb here: HOST clothes I.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise something by rope or tackle is to lift it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Hopeful to swipe pale dresses

indicators.note: a verb: the first word clothes the second by going around it

parts.note: to pale is to fade or decline, as does waning
to swipe is to steal or nab

explanation.surface: An aspiring thief aiming to steal some pale frocks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dresses' is a verb here, not clothing: the first word goes around the second.
explanation.definitionFit: A noun: an aspiring person who wants to be something is a hopeful, an informal synonym.

clue.text: Wild horse at catching distance?

indicators.note: wild letters run free and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A wild horse just within lasso range.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wild' rearranges the letters of 'horse at'; 'catching' means catching a sound.
explanation.definitionFit: The range within which a sound can be heard is the distance at which one catches it.

clue.text: Party sketch in which Gran is discovered, cross

indicators.note: the next piece sits within the party and sketch

parts.note: Lab is short for the Labour Party
a doodle is an idle sketch

indicators.note: uncovered, so the outer letters are removed

explanation.surface: A political cartoon in which a grandmother is revealed looking angry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discovered' means uncovered: Gran loses its outer letters, and 'in which' sets the remnant inside. 'cross' is a crossbreed, not angry.
explanation.definitionFit: A dog bred from a Labrador and a poodle is a crossbreed, so a cross.

clue.text: Respect Eton's principal seconds before lash

indicators.note: the seconds come before the next piece
the principal or leading letter of the word is taken

parts.note: rain that lashes down teems

explanation.surface: A headmaster earns respect moments before the cane comes down.
explanation.definitionFit: Esteem is high regard, which is respect, a noun synonym.

clue.text: Eleven arms here

definitions.meaning: a football team of eleven players; this one is the London club
a store where weapons are kept

explanation.surface: A cryptic note on where weapons are found, with a football team lurking.
explanation.walkthrough: Arsenal is a London football club, and a football side is an eleven.
explanation.definitionFit: An armoury or weapons store holds arms; the football club of that name is a team of eleven.

clue.text: Miss Peron gives back wraps

indicators.note: gives back tells us the concealed letters are read in reverse order
the words Peron gives wrap around a run of letters held inside them

explanation.surface: Eva Peron, the Argentine first lady, handing back some shawls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wraps' hides ERONGI in 'Peron gives'; 'back' reverses it.
explanation.definitionFit: To miss something deliberately is to overlook or disregard it, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Mad with power, books retro fare

parts.note: going bananas is going mad
lit is literature, books

explanation.surface: Crazed with power, someone rereads old books.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retro' looks like a reversal signal; it describes the dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: This dessert of banana, ice cream and sauce is a nostalgic classic, an example of old-fashioned food.

clue.text: Thus unable to show film list

definitions.meaning: with the spool detached from the projector no picture can be shown
as a verb, to recite items one after another rapidly

explanation.walkthrough: The first reading takes the phrase literally: a reel of film that is off the projector.
explanation.definitionFit: To recite a series of things quickly and fluently is to list them, a phrasal-verb synonym.

clue.text: Skill recalled lagging long pipe

indicators.note: lagging is insulating wrapping around pipes, so these letters wrap around the next piece
called back, so the word is turned round

parts.note: art is a craft or skill
to long for something is to ache for it

explanation.surface: Plumbing talk: a skill being remembered while insulating a long pipe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalled' makes TRA; 'lagging' is pipe insulation, so it wraps around the next piece.
explanation.definitionFit: The windpipe is the air passage running from the larynx to the lungs, a pipe in the body.

clue.text: Secreted in hideaway, second wizard

indicators.note: something secreted in is hidden inside, so one piece goes within another

parts.note: a den is a private hideaway
a mo is a moment or second

explanation.surface: A hidden magician tucked away in a secret room for a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: A demon at something is an expert or ace, as is a wizard, so they are informal synonyms.

clue.text: Band artist added to golden casket

indicators.note: the artist is appended after the other pieces

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold
a casket is a small chest
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A musician joining a group, or a painter attached to a gilded box.
explanation.definitionFit: A band of musicians playing together, especially a large group with strings, is an ensemble of this kind.

clue.text: Incentive better for Lucille Ball, perhaps?

parts.note: a carrot is an incentive, as with carrot and stick
to top is to better or beat

explanation.surface: Tempting someone to improve on a comedy star.
explanation.walkthrough: Lucille Ball, the US comedian, was famous for her red hair.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for a red-haired person; the famous redhead of I Love Lucy is an example.

clue.text: Painting in red almost surreal

indicators.note: something surreal is bizarrely distorted, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A canvas done nearly all in red, in the style of Dali.
explanation.walkthrough: 'surreal' rearranges the letters of 'red almost'.
explanation.definitionFit: A work by a great European painter of the past, such as a Rembrandt, is called by this name.

clue.text: Collapse three notes together?

definitions.meaning: to let the air out so something sags and collapses
the notes D, E flat and E played in sequence

explanation.surface: A chord of three notes falls apart.
explanation.walkthrough: Spelt out as notes: D, E-FLAT, E, three neighbouring semitones.
explanation.definitionFit: To deflate is to let air out so a thing collapses, as a tyre does when punctured.

clue.text: Greek princess in song, bottom raised

parts.note: an aria is a song in opera

indicators.note: in a down entry, raised means the word is read upward

parts.note: the end of something is its bottom

explanation.surface: A Greek princess, in an operatic number, lifts her backside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns END upward to DNE.
explanation.definitionFit: In myth the daughter of King Minos of Crete helped Theseus escape the labyrinth: a Greek princess.

clue.text: Old character I see about record

indicators.note: goes about, enclosing the record

parts.note: aha is the exclamation of sudden understanding
LP is a long-playing record

explanation.surface: An elderly person recognising something about a vinyl album.
explanation.definitionFit: The first letter of the ancient Greek alphabet is an old written character.

clue.text: Studio worried, pursued by heartless convict

indicators.note: the first piece is followed by the next

parts.note: to eat at someone is to worry them, and ate is its past

indicators.note: the central letter is removed

parts.note: a lifer is a convict serving a life sentence

explanation.surface: An artist's studio, nervous at being chased by a callous criminal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' takes the middle F out of LIFER, leaving LIER.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist's or designer's workshop is a studio, a French borrowing.

clue.text: With light touch, nothing is jargon

parts.note: a pat is a gentle tap
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A deft hand makes jargon sound like nothing at all.
explanation.definitionFit: A regional dialect or a group's private speech is a kind of jargon, a loose synonym.

clue.text: Children's author pitching up

definitions.meaning: the creator of the Doctor Dolittle books, the vet who talks to animals
throwing or hitting a ball high in the air

explanation.walkthrough: Hugh Lofting created Doctor Dolittle, the vet who talks to animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Sending a ball upward in a high arc is tossing it skyward; the surname is that of the Dolittle writer.

clue.text: Draw round peaks in Andean mountain range

indicators.note: goes round, enclosing the following letters

parts.note: to gut a fish or fowl is to draw it, removing the innards

indicators.note: the peaks or tops of these words are their first letters

explanation.surface: An artist sketching around summits in the Andes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'peaks in' gives A and M, which 'round' puts inside GUT. 'range' looks like the mountains but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The full scale or extent of something, from one end to the other, is its range.

clue.text: Dance pose with ten spins

indicators.note: the letters spin round into a new order

explanation.surface: A dancer striking a pose after ten pirouettes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spins' rearranges the letters of 'pose' and 'ten'.
explanation.definitionFit: A brisk ballroom dance in duple time of the early twentieth century goes by this name.

clue.text: Transport taken from A&E stretched out?

indicators.note: the letters are lifted out from within the longer phrase

parts.note: A&E written out in full is accident and emergency, the hospital casualty department

explanation.surface: Someone carried out of casualty, stretcher and all.
explanation.walkthrough: A&E is a British hospital's casualty department; 'stretched out' asks for it in full, and the answer sits inside accidenT AND EMergency.
explanation.definitionFit: A bicycle built for two riders is a means of transport.

clue.text: Capital has to be invested, lacking infrastructure primarily, and certainly abroad

indicators.note: the first letter of each of these words is taken

parts.note: si is yes in Spanish and Italian, a foreign certainly

explanation.surface: A city needing investment because it lacks basic infrastructure, as seen from overseas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'primarily' takes the first letters of the five words from 'to' to 'infrastructure'.
explanation.definitionFit: The chief city of Georgia in the Caucasus is a national capital.

clue.text: Tense after green snakes set off for location of zoo

indicators.note: the tense letter comes after the jumbled green
the letters snake around into a different order

parts.note: T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense
to spark is to set something off

explanation.surface: Nervous after some green snakes start an incident at the zoo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'snakes' rearranges GREEN to REGEN. Regent's Park in London is home to London Zoo.
explanation.definitionFit: London Zoo stands in a royal park in north-west London, so the park is its location.
